messages.subject: Two GGIR videos now on YouTube
parts:
Dear all,
With the help of my colleague Florian Huber, I recently made two promo videos for GGIR:

The first one is a short pitch to a general audience about what GGIR is: https://youtu.be/RuFBCAqFJ2M
The second one is a mini-tutorial with a screen cast: https://youtu.be/S8YPTrYNWdU

We aim to add the links to these videos to the GGIR documentation for the next GGIR release.
Cheers, Vincent
